inline-size.comment: A raw dimension, following modal.width-* and popover.max-inline-size. A toast width has no semantic ancestor in tier 2 size.

viewport-inset.comment: How far the stack sits from the viewport edge.

accent-width.comment: A raw dimension, like inline-size above: `border-width` in tier 2 carries only `default` (a hairline) and `focus` (a focus ring), and neither means "an intent stripe". Reusing `focus` would tie the stripe to the focus ring, so re-tuning one would silently move the other. The stripe is a SECOND carrier alongside the announced intent word, never the only one.

viewport-max-inline-size.comment: The screen, as a token, so the rule below can subtract the insets from it without writing a literal. A fixed 24rem viewport overflows a narrow phone otherwise, and a toast half off the screen is a toast nobody can dismiss.
